headline: Anthropic launches a Personal Finance feature for Claude
summary: Anthropic released a new Personal Finance feature for Claude that connects to users' bank and card accounts via Plaid, letting them ask questions about their spending. ZDNet notes the access is read-only and frames it as Anthropic's answer to ChatGPT's own finance feature.

claims.statement: Anthropic launched a Personal Finance feature for Claude that connects to bank and card accounts via Plaid.

sources.quote: Claude can now analyze your spending with its new Personal Finance tool
users can connect their bank and card accounts through Plaid
Claude AI can plug directly into your bank account
connects it to your bank and card accounts via the Plaid bank bridging platform.

claims.statement: Users can ask Claude questions about their finances and spending.

sources.quote: where did my money go this month

claims.statement: ZDNet notes the access is read-only.
ZDNet frames the feature as Anthropic's answer to ChatGPT's own Finances feature.

sources.quote: Anthropic has released what appears to be its answer to ChatGPT Finances.
